en-US.description: Effortlessly add watermark to images in tiled mode using this tool with support for PNG, JPG, and BMP.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Watermark Image is a lightweight and user-friendly application for adding tiled watermarks to your photos and graphics. With support for PNG, JPG, and BMP formats, it provides a quick and practical way to protect images, add branding, or personalize your work.

The software features a clean interface that makes watermarking simple for users of all experience levels. You can quickly load an image, choose a watermark file, and instantly preview the result inside the main window. A built-in transparency slider allows you to adjust the watermark intensity in real time, making it easy to achieve the perfect balance between visibility and subtlety.

Designed for speed and convenience, the application displays the original image, watermark image, and processed output side by side, helping you compare results without opening additional windows. Once satisfied with the preview, you can save the final image in your preferred format with just a few clicks.

Whether you are protecting screenshots, branding promotional materials, or adding repeating logos to photos, the program offers a straightforward solution without complicated editing tools or unnecessary features. Its lightweight design and intuitive workflow make it ideal for everyday watermarking tasks.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Watermark Image
